title: Google changes its search box
summary: Google announced a major redesign of its iconic search box with AI-powered features at Search I/O 2026, fundamentally changing how users interact with the world's most popular search engine. The update brings conversational AI capabilities directly into the search interface, marking a significant shift from traditional keyword-based searching to a more interactive, AI-driven experience.
problem_solved: Making search more intuitive and conversational by integrating AI directly into the search interface, reducing friction between user queries and relevant answers.
why_valuable: As Google's search handles billions of queries daily, any UI change affects how billions of people worldwide access and interact with information online.
